added_lines: What if getting started with test automation took days, not weeks?
, getting started with ACCELQ was easier than expected. 🙌

After working across manual and automation testing with different tools, Jasvi found that ACCELQ’s natural language interface and easy-to-build automation logic made onboarding quick and intuitive. Within just 1–2 days, she was up and running!
In this ACCELQ User Spotlight, Tejaswi shares how she uses ACCELQ to simplify regression, API, and mobile testing — and why she believes agentic AI can take things even further.
🎥 Watch her experience with ACCELQ and discover what easier, faster test automation can look like for your team.
